function.description: Sign in to / enroll on a site with the agent's wallet in ONE call: ask its HTTPS challenge URL, sign the returned text, and POST the signature to submit_url on the same site. The tool fills submit_body_json from the challenge it fetched: '{challenge.challengeId}' = that field of the challenge, '{signature}' = the new signature. A key or session the site returns is stored encrypted. Signs login/challenge text only — never a hash, transaction, permit or order.
function.name: wallet_sign_challenge

challenge_body_json.description: JSON object POSTed to challenge_url; '{address}' becomes this wallet's address.

challenge_url.description: HTTPS URL that issues the challenge; '{address}' in it becomes this wallet's address.

credential_label.description: Name for a credential the site returns (stored encrypted; default: its field name).

message_field.description: Dot path of the text to sign in the challenge response; '' = the whole response body is the text (a text/plain challenge).

message_template.description: Only for a site that returns a nonce and expects the client to build a Sign-In With Ethereum/Solana message: the full EIP-4361 text with '{address}', '{challenge.<path>}', '{issued_at}', '{expires_at}' filled in. Anything that does not parse as a sign-in message for this site is refused.

submit_body_json.description: JSON object POSTed to submit_url. Filled in: '{signature}', '{address}', '{message}', and '{challenge.<path>}' = a field of the challenge response. Example for a challenge that returns {"challengeId": ..., "message": ...}: {"wallet": "{address}", "challengeId": "{challenge.challengeId}", "signature": "{signature}"}

submit_url.description: HTTPS URL on the same site to POST the signature to. Give it: without it the signature is sent nowhere and nothing is enrolled or logged in.
